top.title: Trump responds after Vance blames Iran war for midterm losses, VP says his job is to support president
top.rewrite: Trump responds after Vance blames Iran war for midterm losses, VP says his job is to support president
top.summary: Trump said Friday he would launch the Iran operation again 'because we cannot allow Iran to have a nuclear weapon,' pushing back on reports of friction after Vance blamed Republican midterm losses on voter anger over the war and oil prices. Trump said he thought Vance's statement was 'fine.'

featured.title: Putin launches Ukraine barrage hours after Trump meeting amid alleged Russian missile breach of NATO airspace
featured.rewrite: Putin launches Ukraine barrage hours after Trump meeting amid alleged Russian missile breach of NATO airspace
featured.summary: Russia fired more than 400 drones and 110 missiles at Ukraine overnight Friday, killing at least eight people and striking three major bridges in Kyiv, hours after Putin stood with Trump and Xi at their summit in China. Suspected Russian missiles and a drone also entered NATO member Poland.

featured.title: Donald Trump wants Ukraine peace deal by January as he brands Russian missile strike on Poland 'mistake'
featured.rewrite: Donald Trump wants Ukraine peace deal by January as he brands Russian missile strike on Poland 'mistake'
featured.summary: Trump is pressing European leaders to get Kyiv to agree terms with Putin by early in the new year, before he loses control of Congress, according to reports. He appeared to shrug off Russia's strikes on Poland, saying Putin had been 'landing drones in Poland, and a couple of little missiles, by mistake.'

featured.title: Anthropic shares fall after blockbuster opening as wider tech sell-off continues
featured.rewrite: Anthropic shares fall after blockbuster opening as wider tech sell-off continues
featured.summary: Anthropic's shares slid back toward their initial price after a soaring first day as a wider tech sell-off deepened. By Friday lunchtime the S&P 500 was down more than 2% and the Dow 0.7%, with both indexes touching correction territory, 10% or more below a recent high.

featured.title: Mamdani Launches Plan to Empty and Close Rikers Island Jail
featured.rewrite: Mamdani Launches Plan to Empty and Close Rikers Island Jail
featured.summary: Mamdani announced Friday that Rikers Island will close by 2032. AP reports the city is all but certain to brush aside a legal requirement that closure be matched by four smaller, modern jails by 2027. Trump has previously criticised the plan.

left.title: Locals of Michigan city with largest Muslim population in US call El-Sayed election victory 'needed' change
left.rewrite: Locals of Michigan city with largest Muslim population in US call El-Sayed election victory 'needed' change
left.summary: Dearborn residents praised Sen.-elect Abdul El-Sayed's win as the first Muslim American elected to the US Senate, telling Fox News Digital that Michigan 'needed a change.' About half the city's population is Muslim.

left.title: Boebert’s midterm post-mortem: ‘I think it’s all of it’
left.rewrite: Boebert's midterm post-mortem: 'I think it's all of it'
left.summary: Outgoing Rep. Lauren Boebert told the AP that Trump administration policies and congressional stagnation cost her Colorado's 4th District seat, saying gas prices and the Iran war opened a rift between the GOP and working-class voters.

left.title: Mamdani couldn’t explain how NYC-run grocery stores will afford 30% discounts
left.rewrite: Mamdani couldn't explain how NYC-run grocery stores will afford 30% discounts
left.summary: Mamdani has promised five publicly funded, privately run stores selling staples at an average 30% below retail. City documents show taxpayers would build them, pay rent and property taxes and cover operators' discount losses; experts doubt the pledge.

left.title: DeSantis shoots down prospect of sitting on Supreme Court
left.rewrite: DeSantis shoots down prospect of sitting on Supreme Court
left.summary: In a New York Times interview published Friday, outgoing Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis said he doesn't want to 'end up a potted plant on the Supreme Court,' saying he prefers to lead as an executive.

left.title: Supreme Court sitting on emergency petition over Washington’s transgender sports policies
left.rewrite: Supreme Court sitting on emergency petition over Washington's transgender sports policies
left.summary: Wrestler Kallie Keeler, represented by Alliance Defending Freedom, filed an emergency petition on Oct. 2 asking the justices to halt Washington's policy letting biological males compete in girls' sports, after two lower courts declined. The court has yet to act, a question complicated by a newly passed ballot measure.

left.title: Poll: Americans Still Say Most Illegal Aliens Should Be Deported; Only 7% Believe All Should Stay
left.rewrite: Poll: Americans Still Say Most Illegal Aliens Should Be Deported; Only 7% Believe All Should Stay
left.summary: An Economist/YouGov post-midterm survey found 51% say most illegal immigrants should be deported (23% all immediately, 28% most with exceptions), while 41% say only those who committed serious crimes should be, and 7% say all should stay.

left.title: Iran takes pointed jab at Trump Cabinet secretary for moving onto military base
left.rewrite: Iran takes pointed jab at Trump Cabinet secretary for moving onto military base
left.summary: Iran's embassy in South Africa mocked Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent as 'sweetie' on X after reports he moved from his Washington home onto a military base amid security threats attributed to Tehran. He is the latest senior Trump official to relocate behind military gates.

left.title: Hawley leaves door open to 2028 presidential campaign after previously ruling out bid
left.rewrite: Hawley leaves door open to 2028 presidential campaign after previously ruling out bid
left.summary: Sen. Josh Hawley said Thursday he is considering a 2028 White House bid. In September he told the Washington Examiner he had 'no intention of doing so, period.' A run could pit him against JD Vance and Marco Rubio.

left.title: California county under congressional scrutiny over taxpayer-funded voter turnout campaign targeting Democrats
left.rewrite: California county under congressional scrutiny over taxpayer-funded voter turnout campaign targeting Democrats
left.summary: A swing California county's voter registration office faces congressional scrutiny after an investigative report found local election officials used taxpayer resources specifically to turn out Democratic voters for the 2026 midterms.

left.title: REVEALED: Mamdani was arrested TWICE by tactical NYPD unit he disbanded
left.rewrite: REVEALED: Mamdani was arrested TWICE by tactical NYPD unit he disbanded
left.summary: A review of photos and video by Crain's New York Business found the NYPD's Strategic Response Group arrested Mamdani at least twice between 2021 and 2024, including at a June 2024 rent protest at Hunter College. He has now disbanded the unit, as he promised during his campaign.

left.title: Liberals are FURIOUS after Republican wins Alaska seat — with 'spoiler' candidate incarcerated in New York
left.rewrite: Liberals are FURIOUS after Republican wins Alaska seat — with 'spoiler' candidate incarcerated in New York
left.summary: Republican Nick Begich held Alaska's only House seat with about 51.4% of the vote to 48.7% for Democratic-endorsed independent Bill Hill, one of the last midterm races called. Some on the left blame a spoiler candidate who ran as a Democrat and has never visited Alaska.

left.title: Kansas Sen-elect Hamilton won't support Schumer for Majority Leader
left.rewrite: Kansas Sen-elect Hamilton won't support Schumer for Majority Leader

left.title: Van Hollen scores support from another Dem amid Senate majority leader bid
left.rewrite: Van Hollen scores support from another Dem amid Senate majority leader bid
left.summary: Sen. Elissa Slotkin said she will back Sen. Chris Van Hollen for the Senate Democratic leadership role as he challenges Chuck Schumer.

left.title: Hasan Piker claims the far-left is worse off because Dems dominated 2026 midterms
left.rewrite: Hasan Piker claims the far-left is worse off because Dems dominated 2026 midterms
left.summary: Far-left streamer Hasan Piker argued that Democrats' big midterm win weakened progressives' leverage, saying a 40-seat margin means the party no longer needs to make far-left concessions.

left.title: What Democrats are saying about the possibility of a government shutdown in December
left.rewrite: What Democrats are saying about the possibility of a government shutdown in December
left.summary: Sens. Duckworth, Bennet, Sanders and Van Hollen say they will block any short-term funding package that doesn't limit the Iran war, as Congress faces a Dec. 11 funding cliff. House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries has not ruled out a shutdown over the demand.

left.title: EXCLUSIVE: Retired police sergeant issues warning over Mamdani's NYPD shake-up ahead of Thanksgiving parade
left.rewrite: Retired police sergeant issues warning over Mamdani's NYPD shake-up ahead of Thanksgiving parade
left.summary: Retired Sgt. Betsy Brantner Smith of the National Police Association told Fox News Digital she wouldn't take her family to NYC now. Mamdani is disbanding the roughly 500-officer Strategic Response Group, which handles counterterrorism support and crowd control, and she warns of security gaps at the Macy's parade.

left.title: Mamdani Signs Ban Ending 150-Year Carriage Tradition Trump Called ‘a Quintessential New York Experience’
left.rewrite: Mamdani Signs Ban Ending 150-Year Carriage Tradition Trump Called 'a Quintessential New York Experience'
left.summary: Mamdani signed Romanch's Law on Thursday, ending Central Park horse-drawn carriage rides by June 1, 2028. No new licences will be issued, and the city plans to buy back medallions and fund job training for about 200 workers. The council passed it 40-7; Trump had argued the tradition should stay.

left.title: Slotkin snubs Schumer with Chris Van Hollen leader endorsement
left.rewrite: Slotkin snubs Schumer with Chris Van Hollen leader endorsement
left.summary: Sen. Elissa Slotkin said Schumer is not best positioned to lead and she will back Chris Van Hollen. Schumer remains the heavy favourite, with 15 public supporters ahead of a secret-ballot election in early December; Van Hollen had only four endorsements before Thursday.

left.title: Mamdani quietly hunting for ways to thin out Rikers Island population before NYC jail’s ordered closure
left.rewrite: Mamdani quietly hunting for ways to thin out Rikers Island population before NYC jail's ordered closure
left.summary: Mayor Mamdani's team has asked city prosecutors to help cut Rikers Island's roughly 6,000-inmate population ahead of the jail's August 2027 closure deadline.

left.title: Tim Scott ‘happy’ to call Bessent to testify alongside Lutnick about Nvidia chips scandal
left.rewrite: Tim Scott 'happy' to call Bessent to testify alongside Lutnick about Nvidia chips scandal
left.summary: Sen. John Kennedy asked banking committee chairman Tim Scott to invite Bessent to December's hearing with Commerce Secretary Lutnick and export-control chief Jeffrey Kessler over China obtaining US chips. Bessent has faulted Commerce for not blacklisting Megaspeed. It is unclear whether Scott will formally invite him.

left.title: Turns Out Voters Did Blame Iran War For Driving Up Their Costs Afterall
left.rewrite: Turns Out Voters Did Blame Iran War For Driving Up Their Costs Afterall
left.summary: An American Compass post-election poll found about 85% of voters said the Iran war raised their personal costs, more than named tariffs, immigration enforcement or the deficit. Affordability drove the 2026 midterms, in which Democrats won Congress.

left.title: Mamdani to tap just 30 civilian responders to replace NYPD’s 500 cop Strategic Response Group
left.rewrite: Mamdani to tap just 30 civilian responders to replace NYPD's 500 cop Strategic Response Group
left.summary: Mamdani said a civilian 'community dialogue and de-escalation division' of about 30 staff, housed in the Office of Community Safety, will mediate with protesters. It follows his disbanding of the roughly 500-officer Strategic Response Group, whose officers will be reassigned.

left.title: Dems, GOP rebels fail to rein in Trump's Iran war in Senate, but bigger battle looms
left.rewrite: Dems, GOP rebels fail to rein in Trump's Iran war in Senate, but bigger battle looms
left.summary: A non-binding war powers resolution, backed by Democrats and Republicans Collins, Murkowski and Paul, failed in the Senate. It would have required removing troops from hostilities Congress has not authorised. Democrats are eyeing another fight ahead.

left.title: Mamdani refuses to 'walk through the math' when confronted over his plan for city-owned supermarkets
left.rewrite: Mamdani refuses to 'walk through the math' when confronted over his plan for city-owned supermarkets
left.summary: Host Andrew Ross Sorkin pressed Mamdani at the DealBook Summit, noting supermarkets typically run on margins of one to 4 percent.

left.title: Appeals court halts bid to revive Venezuelan temporary protected status after Trump goes to Supreme Court
left.rewrite: Appeals court halts bid to revive Venezuelan temporary protected status after Trump goes to Supreme Court
left.summary: Hours after the Trump administration asked the Supreme Court to step in, a Ninth Circuit panel blocked a lower-court order that would have restored Temporary Protected Status for Venezuelans from Friday. The block lasts until at least seven days after the panel rules on the appeal.

left.title: More voters blame Trump’s tariffs for raising cost of living than Iran war: poll
left.rewrite: More voters blame Trump's tariffs for raising cost of living than Iran war: poll
left.summary: In a November J.L. Partners survey, 22% of voters named Trump's tariffs and trade wars as most responsible for the rising cost of living.

left.title: Trump's money man Scott Bessent secretly moved from home over 'Iranian chemical plot'
left.rewrite: Trump's money man Scott Bessent secretly moved from home over 'Iranian chemical plot' as president weighs...
left.summary: Bessent was moved from his Washington home to a military base earlier this month over threats to his life, which a New York Times report links to an Iranian 'chemical plot'. Asked by Fox's Larry Kudlow about Iranian attempts on his life, Bessent said he would 'not talk about that' and cited a 'high threat level'.

left.title: Horrifying new video shows deadly Brooklyn building collapse in matter of seconds
left.rewrite: Horrifying new video shows deadly Brooklyn building collapse in matter of seconds
left.summary: Eight people, six adults and two children, died and at least 18 others were hurt in the collapse.

left.title: Union immediately sues Mamdani over horse-carriage ban as century-old Central Park industry faces doomsday
left.rewrite: Union immediately sues Mamdani over horse-carriage ban as century-old Central Park industry faces doomsday
left.summary: The union argues the ban strips drivers of their medallions without guaranteed compensation.

left.title: Bernie Sanders Says He Would Back AOC Against Chuck Schumer for Senate Majority Leader
left.rewrite: Bernie Sanders Says He Would Back AOC Against Chuck Schumer for Senate Majority Leader
left.summary: Sanders said he would support Ocasio-Cortez in a direct challenge to Schumer for the Senate Democratic leadership. Sen. Chris Van Hollen has already announced his own bid against Schumer.

left.title: Under-fire DHS boss Markwayne Mullin sidelined by White House after disastrous TV interviews, college football trip
left.rewrite: Under-fire DHS boss Markwayne Mullin sidelined by White House after disastrous TV interviews, college...
left.summary: Mullin has been pulled as the face of the administration's response to the tech outages after criticised comments on the matter and a trip to the LSU-Texas football game.

left.title: AOC leaves door open to 2028 presidential run, signals willingness to work with Trump
left.rewrite: AOC leaves door open to 2028 presidential run, signals willingness to work with Trump
left.summary: Ocasio-Cortez told Fox News Digital 'this election just happened' and her focus is getting results after Democrats reclaimed the House. She also said she is willing to work with Trump on some legislative priorities.

left.title: Democrats could enter congressional majority in a government shutdown
left.rewrite: Democrats could enter congressional majority in a government shutdown
left.summary: House Republicans fear Democrats' post-midterm clout could trigger another shutdown ahead of the Dec. 11 funding deadline.

left.title: Supreme Court urged to defang ‘criminal trap’ that has sent Trump officials to prison
left.rewrite: Supreme Court urged to defang 'criminal trap' that has sent Trump officials to prison
left.summary: Peter Navarro, who served four months in prison for defying a Jan. 6 committee subpoena, has asked the Supreme Court to overturn his contempt of Congress convictions. If the justices take the case, they could make it harder to convict people who refuse congressional subpoenas.

left.title: Aspiring lawmaker is booted from historic Texas country club 'for wellbeing of other members' after he shared shocking anti-Indian videos
left.rewrite: Aspiring lawmaker is booted from historic Texas country club 'for wellbeing of other members' after he...
left.summary: The Republican, who lost his race in the midterms, was stripped of his club membership over his stance on immigration and videos he shared.

left.title: NYC to demolish Brooklyn building near site of deadly collapse
left.rewrite: NYC to demolish Brooklyn building near site of deadly collapse
left.summary: The Department of Buildings said on Wednesday evening that 1323 Flatbush Ave will be torn down.

left.title: Trump reveals 'indications Iran is looking at bioweapons' as he's quizzed over Cabinet members relocating amid growing fears of attack on US soil
left.rewrite: Trump reveals 'indications Iran is looking at bioweapons' as he's quizzed over Cabinet members relocating...
left.summary: Asked about reports of an Iranian 'dirty bomb' threat to Washington, Trump told Fox News there is 'indication that Iran is looking at gasses, looking at bio' and hinted at something after January 1. Rubio, Hegseth, Blanche, Bessent and Stephen Miller are reported to have moved onto a military base in Washington over the threats.

left.title: America's largest IPO ever carries potentially seismic implications for political spending ahead of 2028
left.rewrite: America's largest IPO ever carries potentially seismic implications for political spending ahead of 2028
left.summary: Anthropic debuted at a $1.5 trillion valuation, and its seven co-founders have each pledged to give away 80% of their equity.

left.title: KFC Franchise Operator with 84 Locations Files for Bankruptcy Protection
left.rewrite: KFC Franchise Operator with 84 Locations Files for Bankruptcy Protection
left.summary: Texas-based Tasty Chick'n, which runs more than 80 KFCs in 10 states, filed for Chapter 11 citing falling sales, rising debt and a dispute over unpaid franchise fees.

center.title: Russia open to ‘NATO-like’ status for Ukraine — but only if Putin can keep captured territory: US official
center.rewrite: Russia open to 'NATO-like' status for Ukraine — but only if Putin can keep captured territory: US official
center.summary: A US official said Moscow has signalled it is 'OK' with Ukraine receiving protections similar to NATO's Articles 4 and 5, provided Russia keeps the territory it has captured. The aim would be to get Ukraine 'as close to NATO as possible without the brand.'

center.title: Trump: Iran Wants Deal but Not One He’ll Accept — Demands ‘Real Deal,’ Slams 51 Years of ‘Bullsh–ting’
center.rewrite: Trump: Iran Wants Deal but Not One He'll Accept — Demands 'Real Deal,' Slams 51 Years of 'Bullsh–ting'
center.summary: Trump said Friday that Iran wants a deal but not one acceptable to him, accusing Tehran of stringing people along for 51 years. The remarks followed new talks between US envoys and Qatari mediators as Washington keeps its naval blockade of Iran and weighs more strikes.

center.title: Iran Rebuffs United Front Against It at Trump-Xi-Putin Summit
center.rewrite: Iran Rebuffs United Front Against It at Trump-Xi-Putin Summit
center.summary: Senior Iranian officials tried to frame the Trump-Xi-Putin summit as a win for Iran, contrary to the leaders' joint statement.

center.title: Donald Trump tells Europe to defund Ukraine in blistering 'tirade' against Nato allies as he bows down to Putin
center.rewrite: Donald Trump tells Europe to defund Ukraine in blistering 'tirade' against Nato allies as he bows down to...
center.summary: Trump dialled into the Coalition of the Willing meeting in Berlin from Air Force One, shortly after his summit with Putin and Xi, and told European leaders to stop funding Ukraine, GB News reports. Chuck Schumer called it 'a historic embarrassment'.

center.title: Zelenskyy presses US for expanded Russia talks as Kushner announces breakthrough
center.rewrite: Zelenskyy presses US for expanded Russia talks as Kushner announces breakthrough
center.summary: At the Coalition of the Willing summit in Berlin, US envoy Jared Kushner said Moscow and Trump had agreed to a multilateral negotiating format that includes Europe. Zelenskyy urged Washington to organise a first team-level meeting with full European participation 'as soon as possible', aiming to keep Kyiv and Europe from being sidelined.

center.title: Iran regime's execution spree continues as twins face death penalty, decades in prison after alleged torture
center.rewrite: Iran regime's execution spree continues as twins face death penalty, decades in prison after alleged torture
center.summary: Jailed protesters Taraneh and Romina Rahimi found that the judge hearing their torture complaint against the IRGC was the official they accuse of assaulting them in interrogation, their US-based cousin told Fox News Digital. He said the complaint was dismissed.

center.title: Trump says US will ‘see what happens’ in conflict with Iran after Jan. 1
center.rewrite: Trump says US will 'see what happens' in conflict with Iran after Jan. 1
center.summary: 'We're going to have a new year coming up, and we'll see what happens after Jan. 1. But they've been nasty,' Trump told Fox News during his China trip.

center.title: Trump, Xi and Putin release joint statement after historic talks
center.rewrite: Trump, Xi and Putin release joint statement after historic talks
center.summary: The leaders met for about 90 minutes on the APEC sidelines in Shenzhen. China's CCTV readout made no mention of Ukraine but said bodies like the International Criminal Court should not abuse their jurisdiction; Putin faces an ICC warrant. They also pledged to cut nuclear risks. Hours earlier Albanese told Putin to end the war 'now'.

center.title: One Nation lands $25k donation from Tasmanian salmon company
center.rewrite: One Nation lands $25k donation from Tasmanian salmon company
center.summary: The gifts are the largest received by a political party in Tasmania since new disclosure rules took effect last year. One Nation in Tasmania is led by Lee Hanson, daughter of founder Pauline Hanson.

center.title: Adelaide father and son found guilty of stabbing murder
center.rewrite: Adelaide father and son found guilty of stabbing murder
center.summary: A Supreme Court jury found Brian Slann, 54, and his son Liam, 29, guilty of murdering 21-year-old William Holdback, who was stabbed after a disagreement about drugs. Both had pleaded not guilty.

center.title: One Nation warning as ex-NSW opposition leader quits politics
center.rewrite: One Nation warning as ex-NSW opposition leader quits politics
center.summary: Former NSW opposition leader Mark Speakman, replaced by Kellie Sloane last November, is quitting politics. He is the eighth Liberal MP to announce a departure in recent months, with the party trailing Labor and One Nation in the polls.

center.title: Australian businesses push for beef and rice access to China
center.rewrite: Australian businesses push for beef and rice access to China
center.summary: Albanese meets Xi Jinping in Shenzhen today. Beef and rice exports are on the agenda for a CEO roundtable, along with medical technology, resources and AI in agriculture, as business pushes for market access and trade certainty.

center.title: Kimberley man who whipped and beat partner to death jailed for 10 years
center.rewrite: Kimberley man who whipped and beat partner to death jailed for 10 years
center.summary: The Supreme Court heard Craig Charlton Rastus assaulted the woman for more than half an hour in Mowanjum, inflicting fatal injuries.

center.title: Government, Landbridge rift over Darwin Port deepens as dispute action looms
center.rewrite: Government, Landbridge rift over Darwin Port deepens as dispute action looms
center.summary: Albanese has suggested talks with Landbridge over the Darwin Port lease are continuing, but the Chinese-owned company denies that and says it will press on with international legal action.

center.title: Burke backtracks on backpacker changes as PM is cheered on world stage
center.rewrite: Burke backtracks on backpacker changes as PM is cheered on world stage
center.summary: While Albanese attends global summits, his government faces a Senate grilling over budget measures it is trying to pass.

center.title: Seat by seat, these are the major election issues in regional Victoria
center.rewrite: Seat by seat, these are the major election issues in regional Victoria
center.summary: With a week left in the Victorian election campaign, renewables projects, hospitals and the state of roads are the issues on regional voters' minds.

center.title: Secret briefings reveal warnings about Labor’s ‘ruthless’ data centre pursuit
center.rewrite: Secret briefings reveal warnings about Labor's 'ruthless' data centre pursuit
center.summary: As the Victorian government courted billions of dollars in data centre investment, its top energy officials warned in briefings that the push threatened the state's power grid.

center.title: Calls for One Nation candidate to withdraw from election over misconduct
center.rewrite: Calls for One Nation candidate to withdraw from election over misconduct
center.summary: Anti-violence advocates want One Nation's Murray Plains candidate Garner Smith to withdraw from the Victorian election. He breached five standards of conduct as a Gannawarra councillor, and had commented on a 2022 video of Dustin Martin allegedly touching a woman's breasts.

center.title: Fifth Melbourne Cup revealed as stolen after 'staggering' heists
center.rewrite: Fifth Melbourne Cup revealed as stolen after 'staggering' heists
center.summary: The ABC reports the 1973 Melbourne Cup was stolen from Flemington several years ago and never found. It follows this spring's thefts of the 1948 Caulfield Cup and Makybe Diva's three Melbourne Cups, with racing insiders criticising the Victoria Racing Club's security.

center.title: Live: Victorian election ballots isolated after incident at voting centre
center.rewrite: Victorian election ballots isolated after incident at voting centre
center.summary: Someone gained unauthorised entry to a Richmond voting centre, and the ballots there have been isolated. The Victorian Electoral Commission says there is no suggestion the integrity of the vote has been compromised.

center.title: Anthropic co-founder to make ‘large gift’ to Trump’s investment accounts for kids after record IPO: Bessent
center.rewrite: Anthropic co-founder to make 'large gift' to Trump's investment accounts for kids after record IPO: Bessent
center.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told CNBC that one of Anthropic's founders will make 'a large gift' to Trump Accounts for children over the next few weeks.

center.title: Binance hacker moves nearly $600M in ETH, routes funds through THORChain, Chainflip
center.rewrite: Binance hacker moves nearly $600M in ETH, routes funds through THORChain, Chainflip
center.summary: OnChain Lens tracked nearly $600 million in ETH moved over two days as the hackers shifted the stolen funds through fresh wallets and cross-chain protocols to hide the trail.

center.title: Cathie Wood's Ark Invest piled into Anthropic IPO, buying $90 million worth of shares
center.rewrite: Cathie Wood's Ark Invest piled into Anthropic IPO, buying $90 million worth of shares
center.summary: ARK Invest bought $90 million of Anthropic stock across six funds during its Nasdaq debut, while selling Nvidia shares amid that company's leadership turmoil.

center.title: Anthropic IPO turns thousands of tech workers into overnight millionaires, reports say
center.rewrite: Anthropic IPO turns thousands of tech workers into overnight millionaires, reports say
center.summary: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 a share and opened at $111.50 on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT. CNBC estimates its roughly 5,300 employees hold about $232 billion at the IPO price, averaging some $44 million each.

center.title: Anthropic Stock Jumped 17%. So How Did Some Buyers End The Day Down 13%?
center.rewrite: Anthropic Stock Jumped 17%. So How Did Some Buyers End The Day Down 13%?
center.summary: Anthropic closed at $97.17, 17% above its $83 IPO price but well below the $111.50 opening trade, so buyers at the open ended down nearly 13%. Its filing shows third-quarter revenue near $17 billion, with computing and infrastructure costs up to $9.9 billion.

center.title: Live: Anthropic's record-breaking listing hits Nasdaq, ASX drops
center.rewrite: Anthropic's record-breaking listing hits Nasdaq, ASX drops
center.summary: Anthropic opened at US$111.51, about 34% above its US$83 IPO price, while the ASX fell. NEXTDC's chair dismissed talk of a shareholder class action at its AGM.

center.title: Binance wins $6.5 billion feezing order against hackers behind crypto's largest theft
center.rewrite: Binance wins $6.5 billion feezing order against hackers behind crypto's largest theft
center.summary: The exchange says it has already replaced the stolen assets using its own funds and insurance reserves.

right.title: Pair linked to fake bomb alert outside RAF Fairford to stand trial next year

right.summary: Two men charged over a fake bomb alert outside RAF Fairford, allegedly on Iran's orders, will deny wrongdoing and face trial next year, a court heard.

right.rewrite: Piddington migrant camp 'to be built before legal appeal verdict' as construction set to begin in just WEEKS
right.summary: Construction of the migrant camp at Piddington, an Oxfordshire village, could start in January, before a legal appeal is decided, local MP Calum Miller says. Angela Rayner used special powers to grant permission for the site.

right.rewrite: Piddington migrant camp could be built before High Court decides its legal - with construction set to...
right.summary: Calum Miller, MP for Bicester and Woodstock, said Home Office minister Anna Turley gave him the updated timeline for the site at a meeting.

right.rewrite: Burnham joins European leaders to deepen military backing for Ukraine as Trump holds talks with Russian...

right.summary: Trump said tech firms that build large AI data centres in other countries would face a 'tremendous tax', a threat that could stall billions in planned UK investment.

right.title: Tech outage cascade exposes US vulnerabilities to foreign cyber threats

right.summary: Six days of outages have hit Microsoft 365, banks and the NSA's network. Administration officials have ruled out a coordinated cyberattack, but security experts say the failures show how damaging infrastructure disruption could be in a conflict.

right.title: Hackers use Microsoft Outlook security flaw to steal your login data
right.rewrite: Hackers use Microsoft Outlook security flaw to steal your login data
right.summary: The flaw, CVE-2026-124194, lets a malicious .msg file expose NTLMv2 authentication data, and Microsoft confirms hackers have already exploited it.

right.summary: California attorney general Rob Bonta served an investigative subpoena on Nvidia, probing whether the company's or Jensen Huang's actions let China obtain advanced chips or confidential information. He said that could breach state law if Nvidia misled investors and the public.

right.title: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade could slip to May 2027 over compatibility concerns

right.title: Binance hackers stole 192 tokens across 11 networks, court docs show
right.rewrite: Binance hackers stole 192 tokens across 11 networks, court docs show
right.summary: Stablecoins made up at least $3.46 billion of the $6.3 billion stolen; the hackers also took memecoins, tokenised gold and gaming tokens.

right.title: E.J. Carroll, ‘Law & Order,’ ‘GTA 5’ and ‘Blue Bloods’ Actor, Dies at 66
right.rewrite: E.J. Carroll, 'Law & Order,' 'GTA 5' and 'Blue Bloods' Actor, Dies at 66
right.summary: Carroll died suddenly on Thursday, his rep told Variety; no cause of death has been given. His nearly 30-year career included 'The Deuce,' 'Law & Order,' 'Grand Theft Auto V' and Darren Aronofsky's 'The Wrestler.'

right.title: CMA Awards See a 55% Ratings Bump in Key Adult Demo With Taylor Swift’s Return to the Show
right.rewrite: CMA Awards See a 55% Ratings Bump in Key Adult Demo With Taylor Swift's Return to the Show
right.summary: With Taylor Swift performing at the CMA Awards for the first time in 13 years, the 60th telecast was up 26% in total viewers and 55% among adults 18-49 on last year.

right.title: ‘Home Alone’ Reboot in the Works at Disney from Macaulay Culkin, Seth Rogen and Evan Goldberg
right.rewrite: 'Home Alone' Reboot in the Works at Disney from Macaulay Culkin, Seth Rogen and Evan Goldberg
right.summary: The project is in early development at Disney, with Seth Rogen and Evan Goldberg shaping the script alongside original star Macaulay Culkin and producing through their Point Grey banner. Plot and casting are under wraps.

right.title: Obscured Releasing Picks Up North American Distribution for Finland Oscar Entry ‘The Squirrel’ (EXCLUSIVE)
right.rewrite: Obscured Releasing Picks Up North American Distribution for Finland Oscar Entry 'The Squirrel' (EXCLUSIVE)
right.summary: Written and directed by Markus Lehmusruusu, the film is Finland's international feature Oscar entry: a futuristic drama about a designer of artificial animals whose ordered world is upended when he finds a living squirrel.

right.title: Maharaja Ranjit Singh, the Sikh Ruler Known as ‘Sher-e-Punjab,’ Gets Biopic, Plans 2027 Shoot (EXCLUSIVE)

right.title: Melania Trump attends world premiere for her new docuseries at NYC’s Lincoln Center
right.rewrite: Melania Trump attends world premiere for her new docuseries at NYC's Lincoln Center
right.summary: The first lady premiered her two-part docuseries 'Melania, The Series' at Lincoln Center in New York, following her chart-topping self-titled documentary.

right.title: Bill Hader’s Feature Directorial Debut ‘They Know’ Acquired by Black Bear
right.rewrite: Bill Hader's Feature Directorial Debut 'They Know' Acquired by Black Bear
right.summary: Black Bear bought North American rights to the horror-thriller, which Hader wrote and stars in with Linda Cardellini. MRC fully financed the film, now in post-production.
